property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() succeeds (does not revert) if and only if the caller equals c.owner(); the mutant inverts the check so some non-owners succeed and the true owner reverts, violating that rule.
change_summary: Invert the ownership check so that only non-owners can call functions guarded by onlyOwner (require msg.sender != owner), causing the modifier to revert for the original owner but allow others.
